cand.title: Salon du livre 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and a credible hospitality mechanism; current-edition accessibility is reduced by venue commitment or unresolved sourcing.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified leadership contacts, not proven hotel-contract signatories: Natacha Bayard, directrice du salon, is the primary routing contact for the commercial/operational accommodation owner; Nine Simon, directrice artistique, is relevant to invited-author programming and hospitality requirements. Their current official organisation page confirms both roles. Use the published shared channel info@salondulivre.ch / +41 22 761 11 11, addressed by name; no individual email is established. Ask to be introduced to the unnamed programming/room-reservation coordinator identified in the 2026–2027 staffing notice.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 24–28 February 2027, 41st edition, Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. This is the Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva, Founex/La Côte or Lausanne. The official venue listing and June 2026 exhibition regulations independently state the activity dates; these are not publication dates. Within the requested horizon. No officially announced exact 2028 dates were located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL product: selective accommodation fit, poor main-event/venue fit. A 237-room Founex hotel with meeting capacity around 250 theatre cannot replace this public exhibition. The viable hypothesis is a transport-supported, price-appropriate subset of invited authors, publisher/exhibitor teams or organizers, potentially within the hotel’s supplied 20–120-room commercial band; that band is a sales constraint, not evidenced event demand. No event-specific YOTEL transfer or booking evidence exists. The 12-place fellowship is below that band even before room-sharing is known and its explicit Cornavin hotel location does not fit Founex. Resort-retreat positioning is not supported.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 exhibition venue is officially announced as Palexpo. Regulations: “L’exposition aura lieu à PALEXPO du mercredi 24 au dimanche 28 février 2027.” This establishes the published venue commitment, not access to a private venue contract or a hotel inventory commitment. Palexpo is an exhibition/congress venue, not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Geneva-based series rather than a demonstrated destination-rotation opportunity: citywide Geneva format in 2021–2022; return to Palexpo in 2023; Palexpo again in 2024, 2025 and 2026, with 2027 announced there. The official history describes 2020–2022 as the pandemic-era city format. Moving the main fair to a Founex hotel is not a credible capture thesis.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Organizer-managed lodging is evidenced, but general 2027 hotel procurement remains unconfirmed. A Palexpo Salon staffing notice for 1 December 2026–14 March 2027 requires coordination with “la personne coordonnant la programmation et la réservation des chambres” and communication of transport/accommodation information to invited authors. This establishes an internal room-reservation function, not an open RFP, room volume, or named incumbent. Separately, the 24–26 February 2027 fellowship offers 12 places, jointly supported by Salon du livre and LivreSuisse, and states: “Deux nuits d’hôtel, soit mercredi soir et jeudi soir (réservées par le fellowship).” It specifies an unnamed hotel “à 5 minutes à pied de la gare principale Genève-Cornavin”. No edition-specific named hotel, public housing bureau, published hotel block or open accommodation RFP was located. Verified named lodging hotels: none. Québec Édition’s undated event FAQ says it does not provide hotel reservations; this is only that exhibitor delegation’s channel, not proof of self-booking for the whole fair.
findings.organizationStructure: The public-facing programme is Salon du livre de Genève; the legal organizer is PALEXPO SA. Article 1 of the 2027 regulations says the fair “est organisé par PALEXPO SA”, a société anonyme whose stated purpose includes owning, managing and operating the Geneva/Le Grand-Saconnex exhibition and congress venue. This is a corporate-organized public literary fair, not an association conference or private corporate celebration. No external PCO/DMC or housing bureau was identified. LivreSuisse is the fellowship collaborator, not established as buyer for all event lodging.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The fellowship has a stated central-Geneva hotel arrangement/requirement; the hotel is unnamed and contractual status cannot be verified. Founex does not meet its five-minute walk from Cornavin criterion. No named competing hotel contracts, sell-outs, waitlists or overflow demand were verified. Historical attendance of 61,800 in 2026 is not a room-demand forecast. On-site catering is assigned in the 2027 regulations to Palexpo Restaurants and approved partners, limiting any assumption that exhibition F&B can migrate to YOTEL; a separate off-site gathering would require explicit buyer interest.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Natacha Bayard through info@salondulivre.ch now, with Nine Simon as a secondary programming stakeholder, and request introduction to the person coordinating programme and room reservations. Ask separately about invited-author lodging, publisher/exhibitor teams and the LivreSuisse fellowship; confirm incumbents, committed versus unallocated rooms, nights, budget, transport expectations and renewal/selection dates. Only if an airport-corridor subgroup is available, offer a capped proposal within the supplied 20–120-room band with costed transfers and optional small meeting/F&B space. Do not pitch a venue replacement or imply a published RFP. If 2027 is closed, seek the next hotel-selection calendar without inventing 2028 event dates.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, exhibition space is committed to Palexpo and fellowship lodging is organizer-arranged around Cornavin. Author accommodation has an identified internal sourcing function but no publicly verified opening, hotel names, available allocation or decision deadline. Classify hotel sourcing as unconfirmed, not open and not wholly committed elsewhere. Conditional sales outreach is justified; forecast no confirmed room revenue.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue repeat author/publisher-team accommodation supplier consideration, not relocation of the fair. Official history verifies annual recurrence and the 2027 edition; it does not confirm a 2028 date or hotel tender. Future capture depends on willingness to accept Founex transfers and on incumbent renewal timing. Maintain a future-cycle relationship if 2027 lodging is closed; no 2028 room forecast is justified.
